decisions.reason: As a web-map plugin that builds directly on our existing map.apps and geospatial engineering capabilities and already received dedicated launch communication with multiple releases, it fits strongly with our knowledge base and is worth further refinement.

The hierarchical search plugin is close to our established web-map offer, so our existing technical and customer knowledge gives us good capacity to improve and commercialize it despite still-limited market evidence.

The mobile map layer control component extends our established mobile GIS work and showed enough prominence on the home page to justify continued development using our in-house R&D and usability expertise.

A platform for building GIS solutions is highly related to our core integration and software-engineering competences and strategically strengthens our reusable architecture approach, so we should continue it even if public evidence is still modest.

Mobile field data capture software is close to our established geospatial solution business and addresses a clear customer process need, making it a good candidate for learning and improvement through our existing capabilities.

The search extension for web map apps is tightly connected to our current product stack and customer use cases, so the firm is well positioned to absorb feedback and enhance it rather than exit early.
